import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Sort by user_id, event_ts, event_id (tie-breaking order)
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        ignore_index=True
    )

    # Calendar date (server local, assumed naive) of each event
    events["event_date"] = events["event_ts"].dt.date

    # Identify boundaries: new user OR different date from prev event (same user)
    # OR gap > 45 minutes from prev event (same user, same date)
    prev_user = events["user_id"].shift(1)
    prev_ts = events["event_ts"].shift(1)
    prev_date = events["event_date"].shift(1)

    new_user = events["user_id"] != prev_user
    diff_date = (~new_user) & (events["event_date"] != prev_date)

    gap_minutes = (events["event_ts"] - prev_ts).dt.total_seconds() / 60.0
    gap_exceeded = (~new_user) & (~diff_date) & (gap_minutes > 45)

    new_session = new_user | diff_date | gap_exceeded

    # Global running session id (monotonic across whole sorted frame)
    global_session_id = new_session.cumsum()

    events["_global_session"] = global_session_id

    # Per-user session numbering: rank of distinct global session ids within user,
    # in order of first appearance (which matches event order since sorted).
    # This resets numbering to start at 1 for each user.
    events["session_num"] = (
        events.groupby("user_id")["_global_session"]
        .transform(lambda s: s.rank(method="dense").astype(int))
    )

    # Group by user_id and session_num to aggregate
    user_sessions = events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "session_num"],
        as_index=False
    ).agg(
        session_date=("event_date", "first"),
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count")
    )

    # Ensure columns are in the correct order
    user_sessions = user_sessions[
        ["user_id", "session_num", "session_date", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    user_sessions = user_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "session_num"], ignore_index=True
    )

    return {"user_sessions": user_sessions}
